narrative:
Chart of Accounts administration — the Meridian planning COA is mapped to SAP S/4HANA GL accounts (ACDOCA) across income statement, balance sheet and cash flow.

AI Auto-Map suggests mappings for unmapped GL accounts using Cortex, with high accuracy on standard P&L accounts such as royalties, production taxes and DD&A.

signals.title: SAP GL account export FY2025
signals.excerpt: Active GL accounts mapped to planning leaf accounts; a small number of legacy codes from JV integrations need mapping.
